description: Stores the training plan as LOCAL state (goal, optional start/end, phases, planned sessions per date) in ~/.suunto-mcp/plan.json (SUUNTO_PLAN_PATH overrides it). Writes only that file, never contacts Suunto and NEVER pushes anything to the watch: take a session's `guide` from get_plan and send it with push_strength_guide / push_week_plan. mode 'replace' (default) is DESTRUCTIVE: the call IS the whole plan (goal required; anything left out becomes empty); `previous` in the result holds the replaced plan, so setting it again undoes the call. mode 'merge': given goal/start/end/phases replace the stored ones, sessions merge by date; at least one field is needed, a first merge needs a goal, start and end cannot be cleared. A session is { date, title, guide? } (guide = a push_strength_guide spec dated like the session). Strict: unknown fields, bad dates, items outside start..end, duplicate dates, and over 20 phases / 200 sessions / 500 characters of text (100 for names and titles) / 8000 characters of guide JSON are refused and nothing is written. A damaged or other-version plan file is refused, never overwritten. Demo mode keeps the plan in memory.

goal.description: The goal in the user's words. Required unless merging into an existing plan.

mode.description: 'replace' (default): the call is the whole plan. 'merge': update the stored plan.

phases.description: Training phases (merge: a given list replaces the stored one).

sessions.description: Planned sessions, at most one per date.

guide.description: Optional strength guide spec for that day (push_strength_guide's arguments without guideId); its `date` must equal the session's.

detail.description: Display string for set steps (and prep unless 'plates' is given), with weight and sets, e.g. '60kg 3x10'.

last.description: Optional: last time, e.g. '3x8@60kg' (get_exercise_history suggestion.last). Shown with target in a 'TODAY' popup at prep (36 characters max: shortened, then dropped). Unverified on a real watch.

plates.description: Per-side plates for barbell lifts, e.g. '2x20+1x5/side', shown on prep. Compute it yourself.

restSec.description: Rest between sets in seconds (countdown length; only a label in 'stopwatch' mode).

restTargetHr.description: Optional HR (bpm, 41-200) to recover to: a gauge on this exercise's rests, visual only.

lapGranularity.description: 'perSet' (default; a lap per set and rest) or 'perExercise'.

title.description: Session name shown in the Suunto app.

name: set_plan
title: Set the training plan (local file, pushes nothing)
